headline: Ahead of Second Sale, 'National Growth Fund': Here Are the Returns From the First Round
summary: The citizen-participation National Growth Fund will open its second sales round for two weeks starting on the 30th. The first round sold out, but stock market declines during its early operation have raised return concerns.
why: National investment funds mobilize retail capital for domestic industrial and equity investment. Their performance affects public confidence in state-backed investment vehicles.
